verdict.rationale: Gmail documents automations in the form of filters that label or forward matching mail, and an email product could plausibly version them, so the axis applies. However, no evidence shows versioning, change review, or rollback of filters or other automations. 'Undo Send' retracts an individual message and is an adjacent feature, not rollback of an automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
